profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer
profile.summary: Over 25 years of embedded software development experience encompassing a wide range of responsibilities at some of the most successful technology companies in the world (Arm, Microsoft). Experience marked with extensive customer facing technical engagements and characterized by engineering innovations, process/automation improvements, and successful patent applications that have significantly reduced development time, greatly enhanced product quality, and protected intellectual property.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Stealth Power delivers best-in-class idle-mitigation, mobile power, and clean energy technology solutions to our customers. We develop and manufacture battery-based power systems for vehicle fleets, along with hybrid power systems for remote locations, and stand-alone clean energy systems (wind, solar, etc) that can scale to meet even the most demanding requirements.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Arm ISG focused on delivering embedded software solutions that leverage the advanced security and device management functionality that is available with Arm processors. Many ISG solutions are based on the Mbed OS (RTOS) and secure Pelion Device Management services. The Pelion Products Group within ISG delivers integrated solutions that are based on these core technologies.

positions.title: Owner, Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: On2Next delivers embedded software solutions, consulting services, and training classes that help to reduce time to market, improve performance, and greatly enhance system reliability for a wide variety of embedded devices.

educations.schoolName: The University of Texas at Austin
